title: PeakMine
description: PeakMine is a Vanilla+ Fabric modpack focused on performance, immersion, visual improvements, and quality-of-life enhancements while preserving the original Minecraft experience.
body:
# PeakMine

PeakMine is a carefully curated Vanilla+ modpack for Minecraft Fabric 1.21.11.

The goal of this modpack is simple: improve Minecraft without changing what makes Minecraft feel like Minecraft.

PeakMine enhances performance, visuals, sound, and overall usability while keeping gameplay mechanics completely vanilla-friendly. There are no new dimensions, technology systems, magic mods, quests, or progression changes — just a smoother, more immersive, and more enjoyable version of the game.

## Features

### Performance

PeakMine includes a modern optimization stack built around:

* Sodium
* Lithium
* ModernFix
* FerriteCore
* Noisium
* C2ME
* VMP

These mods significantly improve FPS, reduce memory usage, speed up chunk loading, and provide a smoother gameplay experience without affecting vanilla mechanics.

### Visual Improvements

Minecraft looks better while maintaining its original art style.

Features include:

* Better Clouds
* Dynamic Lighting
* Connected Textures
* Visual particle enhancements
* Falling leaves
* 3D skin layers
* Wavey capes
* Improved HUD animations

The result is a more polished and immersive world that still feels completely vanilla.

### Immersive Audio

PeakMine improves the game's atmosphere through enhanced sound design.

Included features:

* Realistic sound reverberation
* Environmental audio effects
* Improved footstep sounds
* Better cave acoustics

Exploring caves, forests, and structures feels more alive and believable.

### Quality of Life

The modpack includes many small improvements that make everyday gameplay more convenient:

* Better inventory management
* Enhanced tooltips
* Better advancements screen
* Dynamic lights
* Zoom functionality
* Chat improvements
* Resource pack and datapack browser integration

### Vanilla First

PeakMine does not change progression, balance, world generation, combat, or core gameplay systems.

Everything is designed to feel like an upgraded version of vanilla Minecraft rather than a heavily modded experience.

## Who is this modpack for?

PeakMine is ideal for players who want:

* Higher FPS
* Better visuals
* More immersive audio
* Useful quality-of-life improvements
* A vanilla-friendly experience

## Included Categories

✔ Performance
✔ Visual Improvements
✔ Immersion
✔ Audio Enhancements
✔ Quality of Life
✔ Vanilla Friendly

If you enjoy Minecraft as it is but want it to feel smoother, cleaner, and more modern, PeakMine is made for you.
